professionalSummary: Independent developer building web applications and Android apps, with additional experience integrating AI tools. Focused on React, TypeScript, Next.js, backend APIs, and practical product development. Selected projects include a community management platform, a custom ROM discovery platform, a native Android budgeting app, a native Android music player, and an interactive frontend experience. Seeking paid junior developer or internship opportunities where I can contribute to real product work, learn through code review, and grow with an engineering team.

projects.title: Community Management Platform

projects.title: SKY ROMs — Android Custom ROM Discovery Platform
projects.technologies: React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Express, Supabase integration support

Published the project on Vercel; see the repository README for current backend, storage, and deployment configuration.

projects.title: MoneyPal — Android Budget Tracker
projects.technologies: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Android SDK, Room Database, Wear OS

Developed a Wear OS companion and interactive home-screen widgets for quicker expense entry.
Used Room for local persistence and designed the app around offline-first personal finance workflows.

projects.title: Audify — Native Android Music Player

Published repository documentation, screenshots, release information, and build guidance for reviewers.
